name: ElevenLabs
knownFor: A leading consumer and API voice platform for text-to-speech, cloning, and now music and other audio tools.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. ElevenLabs is the most widely discussed dedicated voice product in this set; no public visit-share table was found.
pro: Clear official price ladder and a broad product (TTS, cloning, API)
con: Popularity is editorial; higher plans get expensive quickly
costCaption: Official elevenlabs.io/pricing (checked Nov 2026): Starter $6/month (then; $1 first month), Creator $22/month ($11 first month, labeled popular), Pro $99/month, Scale $299/month, Business $990/month. Annual billing is described as two months free. Rated on Creator, the plan the page marks as popular.

name: OpenAI TTS
knownFor: OpenAI’s text-to-speech and voice features, available through the API and inside ChatGPT.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, with distribution through ChatGPT (55.7% of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026, Similarweb — that is not a TTS-specific figure) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Voice inside ChatGPT or via the API
pro: Comes along with the most-visited assistant in the Similarweb set
con: API cost is usage-based; this row is not a standalone voice studio
costCaption: ChatGPT voice features are rated on ChatGPT Plus at $20/month (OpenAI Help, checked Nov 2026). The OpenAI TTS API is usage-based and billed separately — no monthly total was invented.

name: Speechify
knownFor: A consumer text-to-speech reader, widely used as a listening app for documents, web pages, and study.
learn: Listening to documents and web pages
pro: A clear consumer job (read-aloud) rather than a creator studio
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Speechify sells premium individual plans. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure from the vendor’s pricing page. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on speechify.com/pricing.

name: Descript

con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Descript sells individual paid plans. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure from descript.com/pricing. Editorial estimate $$$ for a typical individual creator plan. Confirm current prices on descript.com/pricing.

name: Google Cloud TTS
knownFor: Google’s Cloud Text-to-Speech API, including WaveNet and Gemini-era voices, billed as a Google Cloud service.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. This is a cloud API, not a consumer app, so website-visit shares do not apply.
learn: TTS inside a Google Cloud project
pro: A mature cloud API with many languages
con: Pure usage-based billing; the cost band is an editorial estimate
costCaption: Usage-based Google Cloud pricing (per character or per request, depending on the voice). No individual monthly seat. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual API spend — no monthly total was invented. Confirm current rates on cloud.google.com.
